Name: Outfit Sets for 1.6
Author: Adalghizar
Description:
The Outfit Sets mod permits multiple outfits to be stored on the player and switched at whim without taking up any inventory space.  The mod has been updated to 1.6. Options have also been added to make it more compatible with mods that adjust the UI.

[b][color=#ffff00]Features:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Maximum Number of Outfits is 12. Default is 6.
[*]Outfit Number colors can be changed.
[*]Placement of the Outfit Numbers can be adjusted. For example, I use "Xoffset": 48, "Yoffset": 580 for my own personal playthrough. Default values are "Xoffset": 48, "Yoffset": 460. Values can be changed in-game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.
[/list]

[b][color=#00ff00]Compatibility:[/color][/b] No conflicts with Fashion Sense. Any Fashion Sense selections will remain constant regardless of Outfit selected. Works well with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27627]Clothing Buffs [/url]mods. Mods that add Ring/Accessory slots may not carry over or cause issues. 
This is my first time doing anything with C#. If there are any issues with multiplayer or other mods, let me know.


[b]Source Code[/b] is [url=https://github.com/Adalghizar/SDV_aedenthorn/tree/master/OutfitSets][font=Roboto, sans-serif][color=#ffffff]Here[/color][/font][/url]﻿
